therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation driven by ALK fusion proteins
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer and advanced solid tumors

results.effect_size: MTD established at 250 mg; 34 participants with tumor response at 225 mg QD (95% CI: 31.1–53.5)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional pharmacokinetics demonstrated with Cmax ranging from 5 ng/ml at 25mg to 182 ng/ml at 250mg
subgroup_findings: 34 participants with preliminary tumor response in ALK positive patients at 225 mg QD
safety_signals: Cardiac disorders including pericardial effusion, acute myocardial infarction, atrial fibrillation
results.dose_information: Dose escalation from 25mg to 250mg daily; MTD established at 250mg; Phase II expansion at 225mg QD
